{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The bounty hunter served the role of the narrator in "[[Almost Had 'Im]]," a short companion narrative included in the [[1994]] sourcebook ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''. The book was authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] and published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG10" />
